dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything I can help with?

dialogues.speaker: Hayaq
dialogues.text: Hmm? You want to help? Well, if you insist... We've already dispatched all our staff, but we've still got an urgent delivery order that needs completing.

dialogues.speaker: Hayaq
dialogues.text: There's a note on the order for it to be sent to <color=#00E1FFFF>a guest with blue pants on the beach</color>. All's well as long as it gets there in time.

dialogues.speaker: Hayaq
dialogues.text: But seriously, thank you for your help. In addition to the delivery fee, I'll also throw in our drink recipe as compensation for your help. I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello, here's your drink.

dialogues.speaker: Aqo
dialogues.text: Oh! Ha! So you're the delivery folks. I was wondering why it was taking so long!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is all your fault! You asked for the order to be delivered to "a guest with blue pants on the beach," but then you went and buried yourself in the sand! We've spent sooooo long hunting down you and your silly blue pants!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You should pay us double the delivery fee!

dialogues.speaker: Aqo
dialogues.text: Ah, in that case, I do apologize. I completely forgot about my note... I should've left my pants out on the sand so you'd have an easier time finding me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But... why are you buried in sand in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Aqo
dialogues.text: 'Cause it's so much fun! I heard it's a thing people do on vacation, so I wanted to try it out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, aren't you doing it wrong? You look more like a carrot stuck in the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Aqo
dialogues.text: Eh? Is that... a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone might trip over you, and you'd both get hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Aqo
dialogues.text: Hmm, I see... I'll think about it. Oh, and here's your fee — doubled it! Thanks again!

dialogues.speaker: Warning Sign
dialogues.text: Watch your step! It is not a ball!

dialogues.speaker: Warning Sign
dialogues.text: Recently, a tourist buried themselves in the sand, only for a passerby to accidentally trip over their head. Both parties required medical treatment. We urge all visitors to stay alert and avoid such accidents.

dialogues.speaker: Hayaq
dialogues.text: I didn't expect the resort to be so popular. Now we're a little short of manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Leave quietly...)

dialogues.speaker: Hayaq
dialogues.text: ...Eh? What a strange person. I thought they were here to help...

dialogues.speaker: Tourist in Blue Clothes
dialogues.text: Good golly, it's hot...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello, here's your drink.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist in Blue Clothes
dialogues.text: Drink? I... didn't order anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've got the wrong person! We're supposed to find a guy with blue pants, not a blue shirt!

dialogues.speaker: Tourist in Gray Pants
dialogues.text: Good golly, it's hot...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello, here's your drink.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist in Gray Pants
dialogues.text: A free drink? Whoo! Looks like the gods have heard my prayers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've got the wrong person! We're supposed to find a guy with blue pants, not gray ones!
